title: Moment register row
description: A node with disproportionate consequence for the actor or the organization (ontology: Moment that matters, prefix MTM). One CSV row is one JSON object keyed by column header; an empty cell means 'not yet known' and is omitted from the object, so 'required' means the cell must be filled. List-valued cells hold IDs separated by ';' with no spaces. Required: moment_id and node_id (identity and where the moment happens), moment_type and outcome_at_stake (what makes it a moment rather than a node label) and evidence_status. The justification, evidence, metrics, failure consequence and owner are filled as the moment is validated.
